## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

List the commands and manual checks used to verify the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Changed Dart code is formatted.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior or setup changed.
- [ ] The pull request contains no credentials, signing material, or private data.
- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated modifications.
